products.sourceDescription:
Begin your magical adventure with Hallmark and delve into the nostalgia of the Harry Potter™ novels with this enchanting Harry Potter™ books hanging ornament. Hang it proudly and make your home magical.



Made of hardwearing resin, this ornament features the Harry Potter™ books stacked up, including Harry Potter™ and the Goblet of Fire, Harry Potter™ and the Deathly Hallows, Harry Potter™ and the Half-Blood Prince, Harry Potter™ and the Order of the Phoenix, and a wand. This ornament comes with white ribbon for easy hanging on your Christmas tree, a book shelf and more.



Hallmark Ornaments are a great way to commemorate hobbies, life events and individual interests in movies, games and more. Each festive and collectible ornament is perfect for sharing with family and friends. The perfect collectable gift for Harry Potter™ fans.

These hanging ornaments are the perfect gift for hanging up around the home at any time of year, and they look wonderful as Christmas tree decorations.



Ornament Measures: 7cm by 6.4cm by 4.4cm 

This is not a toy. For decorative use only.

Get your little witches and wizards ready to travel home from Hogwarts with this classic resin Hogwarts Express ornament from Harry Potter. The perfect way to add magic and mystery to a birthday, Christmas and more.



This ornament features the Hogwarts Express from Harry Potter™ with steam billowing and the 9 3/4 platform sign, and is made of hard-wearing resin with white ribbon to hang the ornament up. Hallmark Ornaments are a great way to commemorate hobbies, life events and individual interests in movies, games and more. Each festive and collectible ornament is perfect for sharing with family and friends. Perfect for fans of Harry Potter.



Ornament Measures: 7.6cm x 1.3cm x 7cm

This is not a toy. For decorative use only.

products.variantName: Hallmark Harry Potter Plush Sorting Hat Tree Topper
products.sourceDescription:
Sit this enchanting Sorting Hat tree topper on your Christmas tree and share the magic of Harry Potter™ with your family and friends. This tree topper is a perfect gift for fans of Harry Potter™ and the Wizarding world. This exciting tree topper is made from lightweight plush fabric and features the infamous Sorting Hat from Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, this hat is best known for sorting the first-years into their new Hogwarts house, Gryffindor, Slytherin, Ravenclaw or Hufflepuff. This tree topper is the perfect Christmas accessory to be enjoyed year after year. Use this tree topper to elevate your festive season, you can also stand the Sorting Hat up to decorate a Christmas party, dinner table and much more.

Tree Topper Measures: W29.8cm x H20.9cm x D29.8cm.

Warning! Not suitable for children under 36 months. Long cord. Strangulation hazard.

Remove all tags and packaging attachments before giving to children.

products.sourceDescription:
Create the ultimate festive Christmas display in your yard this holiday season with our large Christmas display with Santa and reindeer riding a sled inflatable from HomCom. Designed with ultra-durable, weather-resistant, waterproof polyester and featuring an internal white LED glow, this holiday tree will create a festive focal point in your yard, invoking the holiday spirit for years to come. Self-inflating in minutes, this display plugs into any standard outlet creating a super simple set-up process that anyone can do. Build the perfect holiday yard display this year to outdo the neighbours and bring holiday cheer in classic Christmas fashion.



• 1.9m long x 1.22m tall Santa riding a sled with a reindeer

• 8 built-in internal white LED lights

• Self-inflates in minutes when plugged into any standard electrical outlet

• Made from weather-resistant, polyester cloth material

• Comes with all necessary hardware and accessories
